answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cipher is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
